newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.597 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.597 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.597 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.760 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on November 14, raised 916.85 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.598 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on November 7, raised 972.25 million and was priced at 99.557 percent.
